data.about_content:
IGNOU Online is an initiative by Indra Gandhi National Open University established in 1985 by an Act of Parliament to fulfill the aim of creating a knowledge-based society by offering quality education in Open and Distance Learning (ODL) mode. The University began with 4,528 students, and now it has over 3 million population of students from India and overseas. IGNOU provides 21 and 67 Schools of Studies and regional centers, respectively, with 2,667 student support centers and around 29 international partner institutions.

A dedicated department named Centre for Online Education (COE) was established on 7th June 2019 to construct IGNOU as a world leader in digital learning by following modern or trendy technologies to make the learning experience more accessible and affordable to reach out to the maximum number of people, students, or working professionals. The COE is in charge of creating, organizing, and managing IGNOU Online courses and programs. It makes sure the university stays up to date with contemporary educational trends and uses digital media to reach out to every corner of the world.

IGNOU Online resources include video lectures, discussion boards, and digital exams, such as SWAYAM and the IGNOU eContent App, which completely integrate the virtual learning experience. Engaging with professors is made easier and more convenient with the use of email, discussion forums, live online sessions, and virtual counseling.

Under the rules set out by the University Grants Commission (UGC), IGNOU online degrees are accepted and valid for employment, postsecondary education, and competitive examinations. Project Tracking on the IGNOU Online OPT is an online platform created by IGNOU to keep track of students' progress in programs. In order to submit and oversee students’ projects, it facilitates supervisor communication, real-time assignment tracking, and online assignment submission.

Convenience, openness, less time needed for effort than for the project itself, sustainability, and increased communication are a few of the main advantages of IGNOU Online programs. The platform OPT also helps candidates explore IGNOU Online services like digital resources, web-based radio & TV, etc. It includes services like eGyanKosh, Gyandarshan, Gyandhara, Gyanvani, IGNOU library, and virtual classes. Apart from this, the institution provides effective resources by using contemporary technology, such as mobile applications, cloud-based platforms, and digital learning tools.
data.why_choose_content:

NCTE Recognized: The National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) recognizes IGNOU’s teacher education programs.

facts.fact_title: IGNOU Online is a government university that is completely managed and run by the Government of India.
IGNOU Online offers a nationwide student support services network.
The programs offered by IGNOU Online are designed according to the needs of students and working professionals.
IGNOU developed numerous units or centers for student support like EOC, SSC, NCDS, etc.
IGNOU Online has the largest National Digital Library of India
IGNOU Online also contributes to social change; as it has a separate Committee Against Sexual Harassment.
IGNOU Online admits students in two cycles, January and July, via a flexible admissions procedure.

data.admission_steps:
The IGNOU Online admission process was simplified and created to make it simple for students to apply for a range of online programs. Here are step-by-step instructions for the process:

Step 1. Visit the official website or student portal of IGNOU Online and click on the “register” tab.

Step 2. Register yourself to create a “username” & “password”.

Step 3. Re-log in to the system using the username & password (informed through SMS or email).

Step 4. Fill out the application form with all required details and documents.

Step 5. Review your data for confirmation.

Step 6. Make the fee payment (through Credit/Debit card or Net banking).

Step 7. Click on the “Next” tab to preview the form.

Step 8. Do the final submission and also download the form for future reference.

NOTE* The IGNOU Online registration fee is INR 300 /- (non-refundable).

Additional Information:

  • Make sure that you read the instructions carefully given on the website by clicking on the “Declaration” box.
  • No refund after 60 days of the closing date of the IGNOU online admission.
data.emi_content:
IGNOU Online accepts fee payments in both ways, semester-wise as well as annually. Students can make the payments through a Credit/Debit card or with the help of Net banking, but as of now does not provide the facility of No-cost EMI. However, students can seek financial assistance from other financial banks that are globally accepted.

Apart from this, IGNOU Online provides scholarships to students from different categories and has different types of reservations which you may check on the official website of IGNOU.
data.exam_content:
IGNOU Online conducts its end-term examination twice a year, mainly in June & December. The online examination form should be filled out through the student portal or the official website of IGNOU; meanwhile, the exam fee is Rs 200/- per course.

The End-Term theory-based examinations are conducted in online mode but at the chosen examination center by the student. It also provides an admit card, which you can download from the portal 15 days before the exam commencement date for the students to get recognized at the centre. However, assignments that can be handwritten, scanned copies, or typed are accepted, which students need to submit on the online portal.

NOTE* IGNOU Online follows a Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) for the majority of courses.
data.placement_content:
CPC (Campus Placement Cell) is a dedicated placement assistance department at IGNOU Online that takes care of all the placement-related activities for the students or alumni while acting as a bridge between the MNCs and the students to make sure, students will get suitable jobs according to their professional or personal preferences. CPC also assists students in knowing the industry demands and working accordingly on them.

According to the official reports of the last 3 years, IGNOU Online placements or CPC has organized multiple placement drives at various regional or study centers in different cities, where a maximum number of students got placed. Some of the active and key placement partners of IGNOU Online include:

  • Globiva
  • AIR India SATS
  • APTARA
  • Flipkart
  • SBI Life
